answer: Work waits on the echo until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the canyon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
